text:
jess_cs: Heads-up: OrionCorp dedicated pool bring-up scheduled Wed. Need final quota, autoscaling knobs, smoke test window, and a 30-min SRE enablement. Also capture any renewal concerns early. Can ops confirm GPU count and whether we can enable short-term burst?

lee_ops: We can allocate 20 GPUs (5 machines x A100-80). Recommend baseline of 70 rps/GPU given their model mix. Burst yes for first 90m at +25% if KV prewarm is completed.

nina_eng: Traffic details requested: typical sequence length ~512 tokens, p95 latency target 250ms. For autoscale, propose: `rps > 1200 for 90s -> add instance`, and `rps < 800 for 4m -> remove instance`. Also set a cooldown 3m.

tom_se: I'll host the 30-min enablement at 10:00 PT. Agenda: runbook walkthrough, how to trigger fallback, and where to file latency issues. I'll add a short hands-on lab to exercise failover.

infra-bot: Scheduled job: prewarm-kv for orion pool at +12m before test. Job ID: prewarm-20260325-01.

jess_cs: Renewal flag: AMs marked "watchlist" because Orion's latency SLA is strict. If we hit >300ms p95 during first day we'll need quick mitigation and a customer sync.

lee_ops: Shadow test plan: two windows. 1) Quick smoke 15m at low intensity (10k reqs) right after deploy. 2) Full shadow 45m ~90k reqs at peak shape. Command for load tool: `bin/run_load --suite orion_peak --time 45m --requests 90000`. Prewarm KV recommended 15m before full.

nina_eng: Model pin: `orion-base-13b@2026-03-01` quant `nf4` for primary. Fallback: `orion-base-13b@2025-12-15` with `q2_k` if memory pressure. Documented in config repo.

tom_se: Feedback capture: short form + Slack thread for immediate issues. I'll create a Notion doc and share link in onboarding channel.

jess_cs: Ops actionables: confirm prewarm job time, enable burst for 90m, run smoke then full shadow. Eng actionables: apply autoscale rules and model pin. SEs: run enablement and share post-run feedback form. I'll compile into the onboarding checklist and ping AMs after the smoke run. Thanks all :team_parrot:
